item.title: Introduction to JSON Web Tokens
item.description: What is JSON Web Token? JSON Web Token (JWT) is an open standard (RFC 7519) that defines a compact and self-contained way for securely transmitting information between parties as a JSON object. This information can be verified and trusted because it is digitally signed. JWTs can be signed using a secret (with the HMAC algorithm) or a public/private key pair using RSA or ECDSA. ​ JSON Web Token (JWT) 是
